blocks.text: Condo buildings in Langley Condos for Sale
Streets, schools and getting around Langley Condos for Sale

items.t: Scope: the board/SnapStats community "Langley," combining the Township and the City across eleven sub-areas: Aldergrove, Brookswood, Campbell Valley, County Line Glen Valley, Fort Langley, Langley City, Murrayville, Otter District, Salmon River, Walnut Grove and Willoughby Heights.

Community context: Langley Condos & Townhomes median $611,000, $513/sq ft, 97% sale-to-list, 25 days; detached median $1,345,000. There is no condo-only split in SnapStats — condo-only figures are not verified.

Sub-area attached context (active / sold / sales ratio, September 2026): Willoughby Heights 369 / 70 / 19%; Langley City 195 / 34 / 17%; Walnut Grove 55 / 10 / 18%; Murrayville 35 / 8 / 23% (highest attached ratio, small base); Aldergrove 30 / 5 / 17%; Fort Langley 9 / 1 / 11% (small-count caution). SnapStats publishes medians at community level only — per-sub-area medians are not verified.
The feed's total size and exact filter criteria are not verified.
Catchment for any specific condo address: Not verified — no SD35 locator run for a condo building address is on record.

SkyTrain: the Surrey Langley SkyTrain extension ends at Langley City Centre station; the Province states all eight stations along the 16-kilometre extension are under construction, with operation expected in late 2029.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Langley Condos for Sale

items.t: Two municipalities, two rule sets: City of Langley Zoning Bylaw 2025 No. 3300 governs the City buildings; its adoption date is not confirmed (sources differ). City suite cap: the lesser of 100 m² and 40% of gross floor area, registered owner must reside on the lot; City SSMUH Bylaw No. 3284, adopted June 17, 2024 (RS1/RS2: 4 units, or 6 within 400 m of a frequent bus stop). Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw No. 2500 governs the Township buildings; Township SSMUH Bylaw No. 6020 (adopted November 18, 2024) has no six-unit tier — 3 units on lots of 280 m² or less, 4 units on lots between 280 m² and 4,050 m² — and the Township suite cap is 120 m². Township gentle-density context only; it does not change an existing strata building's bylaws.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Langley Condos for Sale
What Langley land means in this topic's frame

items.t: Fee-simple lots — the default form for Langley land: A coach house is not a townhouse complex and is counted nowhere as one.

The R-CL small-lot rules (Township Zoning Bylaw 2500 s.403) set a 220 m² minimum and 464.5 m² maximum lot area — there is no 355 m² figure in the bylaw, so a 355 m² R-CL cap is incorrect. That is a zoning fact about Township small lots, not an inventory of lots for sale.

Assemblies / proposals — documented as such, never as inventory: The Surrey Langley SkyTrain extension (all eight stations under construction, operation expected late 2029) is infrastructure under construction, not a lot offering.

items.t: What the page covers: a housing-form feed page, not an area page — headed "Langley Condos for Sale | MLS® Listings," carrying editorial copy organized by condo district (Willoughby/Latimer/Carvolth, Walnut Grove, Murrayville, Langley City) above a live MLS® feed of condo listings: a condo-only MLS® filter laid over all of Langley (Township of Langley plus the separate City of Langley).

Board identity: Langley is a Fraser Valley Real Estate Board (FVREB) community in the SnapStats data, with 11 sub-areas; the Condos & Townhomes sub-area rows most relevant to this feed are Willoughby Heights, Langley City, Walnut Grove and Murrayville — as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report.

SkyTrain (Surrey Langley SkyTrain): the extension will end at Langley City Centre station; the Province's project reporting states all eight stations along the 16-kilometre extension are under construction, with the extension expected to enter operation in late 2029, extending the Expo Line from King George Station in Surrey to Langley City Centre.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Langley Condos for Sale

items.t: TOWNSHIP — plans + zoning: Zoning Bylaw 2500. The Willoughby Community Plan was Bylaw 1836 and is now Schedule 6 to Bylaw 6200 (adopted December 1, 2025); the Willoughby Plan Update Bylaws 6201/6202/6203 had first/second reading May 25, 2026 only — never describe them as adopted or as having replaced the plan.
Township SSMUH: Bylaw 6020 tops out at 4 units, with no 6-unit tier. The Township suite cap is 120 m². A Township coach house is a fee-simple unit under s.102 of Bylaw 2500, never strata.
TOWNSHIP — R-CL small lots: Zoning Bylaw 2500 s.403 (R-CL) = 220 m² minimum / 464.5 m² maximum lot area (no 355 m² figure).

CITY — zoning + SSMUH: City of Langley Zoning Bylaw 3300 by number — cite the number; its adoption date is not verified (conflicted in sources). City suite cap = the lesser of 100 m² and 40% of gross floor area, with the registered owner required to reside on the lot.

Strata diligence (the BC strata block — applies to the 22 buildings' strata lots and in full to any bare-land strata lot): Form B diligence (fees, amounts owed, levies, CRF balance, insurance summary; provided within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page) — read it with the depreciation report, contingency reserve and any special levies before pricing an offer; depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws void since November 24, 2022 (short-term restrictions may still apply by bylaw); only 55+ age bylaws valid under Strata Property Act ss. 123.1/123.2, with May 1, 2023 exemptions (younger spouse/partner, caregivers, legacy residents, defined children); a listing's "45+" line is not a valid BC age bylaw.

ALR rules (carried for any Township parcel where reserve status is confirmed — no parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within the principal residence only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha).

Confirm the municipality on title before comparing anything.
faq.q: Are Langley City and the Township the same for lot rules?

faq.a: No. Township Bylaw 6020 has no six-unit tier: 3 units on lots of 280 m² or smaller, 4 units on lots up to 4,050 m². The 6-unit figure belongs to the City of Langley's Bylaw 3284, and only within 400 m of a frequent bus stop in RS1/RS2 — a different municipality's rule.
faq.q: Can I build a 6-plex on a Township lot under SSMUH?

faq.a: By the combined Condos & Townhomes sub-area rows, Willoughby Heights holds by far the largest attached inventory — 369 of Langley's 699 listings in September 2026, with 70 solds — followed by Langley City at 195 listings and 34 solds (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats). Willoughby, Latimer and Carvolth are also where much of the new condo building in the Township has happened.
